name: ChatGPT Advertising Experiment Plugin
description: Install a task-led ChatGPT Ads experiment workflow with planning skills, read-only API access, conversion reconciliation, policy gates, and a one-command mock lab.

requires_setup: Python 3.9 or newer is required to run the offline mock lab.
limitations: The included OpenAI Ads client does not mutate campaigns, ad groups, ads, files, or feeds.
Live provider writes remain unavailable until a supported OpenAI Ads mutation adapter is implemented and independently verified.
usability.quickstart: Run `python3 scripts/run_mock_lab.py` after installation to create an offline evidence bundle.

limitations: Requires Python 3.9 or newer and performs no network calls.

authentication.credential_storage: The account-scoped API key remains in the provider tool's explicitly bound environment source and is never copied into plugin state.
authentication.validation: The included provider tool calls GET /ad_account and binds readiness to the provider-attested account identifier.
authentication.revocation: Revoke or rotate the account-scoped API key in OpenAI Ads Manager and remove its provider-tool binding.

capability_readiness.name: Mock lab
capability_readiness.description: Run the deterministic experiment, conversion-validation, and reconciliation workflow without credentials or network access.
limitations: Uses packaged fixtures only and cannot establish provider readiness.

capability_readiness.name: Live read
capability_readiness.description: Read bounded OpenAI Ads account, campaign, ad, and insights data through the authenticated read-only client.
requires_setup: Configure and verify the included OpenAI Ads API client against the intended provider account.
limitations: Provider authentication attests the ad account rather than the individual human owner of the API key.

capability_readiness.name: Live write
capability_readiness.description: Apply a provider mutation only through exact approval, a single-use grant, governed execution, and reconciliation.
limitations: No supported OpenAI Ads mutation adapter is included, so control-plane or executor setup cannot enable provider writes.
